title: Unit Event — Knowing the Unseen — Episode7 The Emotions I See

meta.Event Outline: Ena debates whether she should aim for art school post-graduation. With this inner turmoil comes restlessness, which begins to affect her art. Mr. Yukihira notices that she's struggling, and after she divulges the cause, he invites her to take part in an excursion.

rows.Line: Exhibit Hall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We're here!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This is where Ena's dad is holding his art exhibit?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I always thought solo exhibitions took place at smaller venues... I guess it just means he's that famous.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't wait to see what's inside!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The theme for this exhibit is “Deep in the Night”, so the art we're going to see may all have something to do with that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
Wait, Mafuyu, you knew beforehand?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade seemed interested, so we did some research.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd seen some of Ena's dad's works in the past, so I've been looking forward to this a little...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Then, I'm glad we came!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Where do you think Ena is...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, good question.
I was under the impression that she'd be by the reception...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we may have a hard time finding her since she's also supposed to be helping out behind the scenes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it'd still be nice to see her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I mean, Ena really doesn't like having anything to do with her dad.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So I hope she's okay.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Look. Over there...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's Ena!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What if...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What if your dad was having trouble painting, Ena?>

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: He'd finally begun his journey as a painter, but no one seemed interested in looking at his art, let alone understand it.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: He drew and drew as much as he could. He was so desperate.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (There was a time when nobody would look at his art...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And he seriously thought about quitting?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm having a hard time believing that...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If that's true...)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: But if you're serious about becoming a professional, you'll keep facing what you are now time and time again.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: The difference between those with talent and those without is that those without have to work much harder to be on the same level. More than you can imagine...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I'm saying that you'll keep feeling this pain if you choose to continue drawing...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You won't always be able to produce works that satisfy you. Can you deal with that pain moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(He struggled to produce anything that he was satisfied with.
The thought of not being able to create art agonized him.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (He felt pain with each brush stroke, which was only made worse by people not showing any interest in what he was doing.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And yet, he chose to keep creating...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Which means I...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I should also...)

rows.Speaker: Visitor A
rows.Line:
Shinonome's such an amazing artist.
All of his paintings are just so wonderful...!

rows.Speaker: Visitor B
rows.Line: Based on the theme of this exhibit, I will say that there are a lot of dark and gloomy pieces... But they're all really beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Visitor A
rows.Line:
I agree.
It's no wonder that he's hailed as a modern master. He's produced a fabulous feast for our eyes.

rows.Speaker: Visitor A
rows.Line: With “A Peony Blooming in the Night” as the piece de resistance. It's just so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I always saw this one as just another pretty painting...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (There was something mystical about this peony blooming while surrounded by darkness.)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
As you know, he didn't end up quitting.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I don't fully understand the pain he felt or how he figured out what he needed to do.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I do know that he decided to fully commit himself to his art.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: He decided to fully commit himself to his art...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What state of mind was he in...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (How was he able to actually do that...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena has a serious look on her face...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: By the looks of things, I think we have nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's give her some space for now.
